experiment: Slab synthetic dataset (2-d features, binary label), MLP (representation + classifier FC nets), source domains with linear-noise p=0.0 and 0.1, target domain p=1.0, methods ERM, DANN, MMD, CORAL, RandMatch, CDANN, C-MMD, C-CORAL, PerfMatch
notes: Table 1 caption states mean and standard deviation over 10 different seed values for each method. Main text page 7 says 'All the numbers are averaged over 3 runs with standard deviation in brackets', which concerns the other experiments; Table 1's own caption (10 seeds) is used here.
Slab parameters: k=7 slabs, margin m=0.1, slab label-flip probability ps=0.1; linear-feature noise p=0.0 and 0.1 for sources, 1.0 for target.
Validation: 250 additional points per source domain, used for hyperparameter tuning (model selection) and early stopping on validation loss over 100 epochs.

Per-method lambda (optimal values, Table 7): DANN 0.01 (gradient penalty 0.1, discriminator steps 4); CDANN 0.01 (gradient penalty 1.0, discriminator steps 2); MMD 0.1; C-MMD 0.1; CORAL 0.1; C-CORAL 0.1; RandMatch 1.0; PerfMatch 1.0. Loss objective is ERM + lambda*Regularization Penalty.
Paper does not state momentum, Nesterov, lr schedule, normalization, resize or augmentation for the slab experiment. The paper says the Slab 'linear' feature noise is a domain-dependent change.

Appendix C.3 says early stopping uses validation accuracy on source domains for hyperparameters in general, while A.1 for the slab dataset says early stopping on validation loss; A.1 and Table 7 are used for the slab experiment.
Test points: 1k target-domain points used for evaluation.
